tickets.title: Consolidate the five replicated ADLC phase routers into a single source of truth
tickets.body:
PROBLEM. The ADLC phase-router content (the "where am I / which gate" map plus per-phase gate descriptions) is duplicated across five harness plugins in three file conventions:
  - plugins/adlc-claude-code/skills/adlc/SKILL.md   (prose phase list)
  - plugins/adlc-codex/skills/adlc/SKILL.md          (prose phase list)
  - plugins/adlc-pi/skills/adlc/SKILL.md             (prose phase list)
  - plugins/adlc-opencode/skill/adlc.md              (table + prose)
  - plugins/adlc-cursor/rules/adlc.mdc               (Cursor .mdc table)
This replication is a drift hazard: an edit can update some harnesses and miss others. It happened during PR #55 (opencode and cursor were initially omitted from a router edit), and PR #55's whole-branch review (independent agy and opus reviewers) flagged the replication as a LOW maintenance hazard with the recommendation to consolidate to a single source of truth.

GOAL. Define ONE canonical source for the phase-router content and generate each harness's router file from it, so a single edit propagates to all five and a CI check fails if any harness drifts. Preserve each file's required format and front-matter (prose for the three SKILL.md files; a table for the cursor .mdc and opencode adlc.md).

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (each with a concrete verification method):
AC1 - A single canonical source file exists (e.g. docs/router/phase-router.yaml or a module under packages/) holding the phase map + per-phase gate text + the adversarial-review discoverability content. Verify: the file exists and is the input the generator reads (grep the generator for its path).
AC2 - A generator/build step emits all five harness router files from the canonical source, preserving each file's format and any YAML/frontmatter. Verify: run the generator on a clean checkout, then `git diff --exit-code` on the five router paths returns 0 (generated output equals committed).
AC3 - A CI-runnable drift check fails when any harness router diverges from the canonical source. Verify: hand-edit one generated router, run the check, assert non-zero exit; regenerate, assert exit 0.
AC4 - The PR #55 discoverability content survives consolidation: every generated router names `adversarial-review` at P1/P3/P5 and contains the exact phrase `exit 0 = SHIP`. Verify: after generation, grep each of the five files for `adversarial-review` and `exit 0 = SHIP`; all five match.
AC5 - No routing regression: each generated router carries the same phase->gate mapping it had pre-consolidation. Verify: compare the semantic phase->gate content of each generated router against its pre-consolidation version (git show HEAD:<path>); differences are limited to formatting/source-derivation, not routing changes.

CONTEXT. Related to PR #55 (ADR-0008 adversarial-review coverage map). The router files were last edited there; use their current committed form as the content baseline to extract into the canonical source. Suppressions are denied.

tickets.title: Cursor: deploy .cursor/commands/ from the scaffolder + full phase command suite
tickets.body:
Bring the Cursor integration's command surface to parity with the OpenCode integration, on Cursor's native `.cursor/commands/*.md` surface.

=== BUG TO FIX FIRST (TDD: failing test first) ===
plugins/adlc-cursor/lib/scaffold.mjs never deploys the package's command/ directory into the user's .cursor/commands/. The package ships command/adlc-init.md and docs/integrations/cursor.md claims "Inside Cursor you can also run the /adlc-init command", but after scaffolding, .cursor/commands/ does not exist — the command is unreachable. Add a deployCommands() step to scaffold() mirroring plugins/adlc-opencode/lib/scaffold.mjs's deployDir() (idempotent: re-run overwrites from package source, never deletes unrelated files; source of truth is the package).

=== COMMAND SUITE ===
Author these commands in plugins/adlc-cursor/command/ (Cursor commands are plain markdown; bare /adlc-<name> form — Cursor has NO plugin-namespace convention, do NOT use the /adlc:adlc-* Claude Code form):
- adlc-ticket.md (P0) — adapt from plugins/adlc-opencode/command/adlc-ticket.md; author into .adlc/tickets.json, then coldstart-check executability (--prompt-only: the in-session model answers the printed audit).
- adlc-spec.md (P1) + adlc-approve-spec.md — adapt from OpenCode's pair: draft spec into .adlc/specs/, run adlc spec-lint, premortem --prompt-only, record approval.
- adlc-decompose.md (P2) — adapt from OpenCode: slice an approved spec into tickets, model-router/merge-forecast.
- adlc-verify-build.md (P4) — adapt from OpenCode: flail-detector + targeted test run for the active ticket.
- adlc-prosecute.md (P5) — STUB in this ticket only: a placeholder routing to `adlc hollow-test` / `behavior-diff` / `npx adversarial-review` (the full multi-lens loop is ticket T17; do not build it here).
- adlc-distill.md (P7) and adlc-maintain.md — adapt from plugins/adlc-claude-code/commands/ equivalents (lesson-foundry + rejection-mining --prompt-only; skill-rot / model-ratchet / ticket-prune).
Every command: frontmatter with description, body references gates via the `adlc <tool>` dispatcher, notes --prompt-only for LLM-backed gates (no API key in-session).

=== ROUTER ===
scripts/router/router-model.mjs is the single generated source for all six phase routers (T13/T14 doctrine — NEVER hand-edit plugins/adlc-cursor/rules/adlc.mdc). Add/extend the cursor harness entry so the generated rule references the new bare /adlc-* commands where the other harnesses reference theirs, then regenerate via `node scripts/router/gen-routers.mjs` and verify `node scripts/router/gen-routers.mjs --check` passes plus `node --test scripts/test/router-drift.test.mjs`.

=== ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA ===
- AC1: after `node plugins/adlc-cursor/lib/scaffold-cli.mjs <tmp-repo>`, .cursor/commands/ contains every plugins/adlc-cursor/command/*.md file. VERIFY: new test in plugins/adlc-cursor/test/scaffold.test.mjs runs scaffold() against a temp dir and asserts each shipped command file lands.
- AC2: re-running scaffold() is idempotent (no duplicates, package source wins). VERIFY: same test, second run.
- AC3: all 8 commands exist with valid frontmatter (description field). VERIFY: extend scripts/cursor-install-smoke.mjs to assert each command file exists + has description frontmatter, mirroring the OpenCode smoke's per-command checks.
- AC4: generated rule references the commands; no hand-edits to adlc.mdc. VERIFY: `node scripts/router/gen-routers.mjs --check` exits 0 and router-drift test passes.
- AC5: no bare-command guard regression for other harnesses. VERIFY: `node scripts/claude-code-plugin-smoke.mjs .` still exits 0.
- AC6: no sibling regression. VERIFY: `node scripts/opencode-install-smoke.mjs .` and full `npm test` exit 0.

tickets.title: Extract prosecutor convergence lib to @adlc/core; Cursor /adlc-prosecute multi-lens loop
tickets.body:
Give Cursor the P5 multi-lens prosecution the other two full integrations have, WITHOUT creating a third hand-copy of the convergence logic.

=== PART A: extraction (issue-#97 pattern, same playbook as scaffold-hygiene) ===
plugins/adlc-claude-code/lib/prosecutor.mjs and plugins/adlc-opencode/lib/prosecutor.mjs are byte-identical except one comment line (verify with diff before starting). Extract to packages/core/lib/prosecutor.mjs, re-export from @adlc/core's index.mjs + index.d.ts (types for the exported registry/dedupe/verify/converge functions). Both plugins' lib/prosecutor.mjs become thin import + re-export shims (their existing tests must keep passing UNCHANGED — do not edit the frozen test files; see rails). Move the duplicated behavioral tests into packages/core/test/prosecutor.test.mjs (they are duplicated across plugins/adlc-claude-code/lib/test/prosecutor.test.mjs and plugins/adlc-opencode/test/prosecutor.test.mjs — consolidate the shared cases; the per-plugin files stay as-is per rails, still passing against the re-exported surface). Add NEW per-plugin delegation test files (plugins/adlc-claude-code/lib/test/prosecutor-delegation.test.mjs, plugins/adlc-opencode/test/prosecutor-delegation.test.mjs) asserting reference equality with @adlc/core's exports — new files, so the frozen existing test files are untouched.

=== PART B: Cursor /adlc-prosecute ===
Replace the T16 stub plugins/adlc-cursor/command/adlc-prosecute.md with the full loop, adapted for Cursor's constraints: Cursor has NO subagent fan-out (no Task tool, no @agent syntax). The loop therefore runs the five lenses SEQUENTIALLY in one context (correctness, security, contract, diff, tests — port each lens brief from plugins/adlc-opencode/agent/prosecutor-*.md into either the command body or lens section files under plugins/adlc-cursor/command/), then dedupes by file+line-range+title keeping highest severity, then verifies each deduped finding via a sixth verifier pass, repeating until two consecutive rounds surface no new confirmed findings — same convergence contract as the siblings, driven by the shared @adlc/core prosecutor lib where logic is mechanical (dedupe/converge) and by command instructions where it is judgment (the lens briefs). HONESTY REQUIREMENT: the command and docs MUST state that sequential same-context lenses have weaker independence than the siblings' fresh-context subagent fan-out, and recommend `npx adversarial-review --providers <a,b>` for the cross-model risk gate — do not overstate parity.

=== ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA ===
- AC1: exactly one implementation of the prosecutor convergence logic exists (packages/core/lib/prosecutor.mjs). VERIFY: grep shows both plugins' lib/prosecutor.mjs contain no LENSES/dedupe/converge implementation, only re-exports.
- AC2: both siblings' EXISTING prosecutor test files pass unchanged. VERIFY: `node --test plugins/adlc-claude-code/lib/test/prosecutor.test.mjs plugins/adlc-opencode/test/prosecutor.test.mjs` green with zero diff to those files (git diff --stat confirms).
- AC3: delegation tests catch a reintroduced local copy. VERIFY: new delegation test files pass; temporarily shadowing the re-export in one plugin makes its delegation test fail (documented RED/GREEN in the PR).
- AC4: consolidated behavioral tests live in packages/core/test/prosecutor.test.mjs and pass. VERIFY: node --test on that file.
- AC5: Cursor command implements the full loop with the honesty caveat present. VERIFY: extended scripts/cursor-install-smoke.mjs asserts adlc-prosecute.md exists, references all five lens names + verifier, and contains the weaker-independence caveat text.
- AC6: full `npm test` exits 0.

tickets.title: Cursor hook parity: buildgate, flail, stop-audit, preflight, shell advisory
tickets.body:
Bring the Cursor hook surface to parity with the Claude Code plugin's six hook modes (rails, buildgate, preflight, flail, manifest, review), within what Cursor's hook events support.

=== PINNED CURSOR HOOK FACTS (ADR-0006) ===
Events pinned against docs: preToolUse (blockable, JSON stdin/stdout, permission allow|deny|ask), afterFileEdit (observational, cannot block), beforeShellExecution, beforeReadFile. NOT yet pinned: `stop` and `beforeSubmitPrompt`. VERIFY-FIRST DISCIPLINE: before wiring stop/beforeSubmitPrompt, verify against current Cursor hooks documentation that the event exists and pin its payload shape in ADR-0006 (same defensive-extraction approach the preToolUse adapter uses). If an event cannot be verified, ship that mode DISABLED-by-default with a documented enable flag and a pinning TODO — do not wire an invented event name as if real.

=== MODES TO ADD (all advisory except buildgate, which mirrors rails' best-effort deny) ===
1. buildgate (preToolUse, second entry): port the fitness-to-build gate (issue #48; reference implementation plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/adlc-hook.mjs buildgate mode). Deny a structured edit when the active ticket is high-risk AND the session context-fitness signal is degraded, unless ADLC_BUILD_GATE_BYPASS=1 with an audited gate-manifest record. Risk-tier/decide logic MUST be imported from @adlc/build-gate (packages/build-gate — it already exists as the reusable Path-A toolkit package; do NOT hand-copy the KEEP-IN-SYNC port the CC hook uses — Cursor hooks already resolve workspace deps, same as @adlc/core in rails-checker.mjs). Context-fitness input: Cursor hooks do not receive a transcript_path; derive depth from a session tool-call counter persisted under .adlc/ by the hook itself (document the proxy's weakness honestly) or accept ADLC_BUILD_GATE_DEPTH env input.
2. flail (afterFileEdit, piggyback in adlc-audit.mjs): after the rail audit, run the flail heuristics (packages/flail-detector primitives) over the hook's own persisted recent-edits window; advisory stderr notice only.
3. stop-audit (stop event, IF pinnable): run `adlc gate-manifest verify --json` + the risk-gated adversarial-review check (packages/core/lib/risk-tier.mjs decideAdversarialReviewNotice — same logic as issue #59's CC/OpenCode triggers); advisory notice only.
4. preflight (beforeSubmitPrompt, IF pinnable): once per session (persist a marker under .adlc/), run `adlc preflight --json`; advisory. Include the ADLC precedence assertion when .adlc/ exists ("route work through the ADLC gates; other process skills plug into phases").
5. shell advisory (beforeShellExecution): NEVER deny. Pattern-match the command string for obvious writes to the active ticket's rail paths or trust roots (.adlc/tickets.json, .adlc/current-ticket.json) — e.g. redirection/sed -i/rm/mv/cp targets — and emit an advisory agent_message reminding that CI catches rail edits regardless of how they are made. Document plainly this is trivially bypassable and exists only to keep an honest agent honest (ADR-0006 threat model: shell is Turing-complete, the CI gate is the control).

=== WIRING ===
Extend plugins/adlc-cursor/hooks.json + lib/scaffold.mjs mergeHooks() for the new entries (all failClosed:false; buildgate matcher '.*' like rails). mergeHooks must remain idempotent and non-clobbering for user hooks; isAdlcHook() must recognize the new script names.

=== ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA ===
- AC1: buildgate denies a high-risk-ticket edit past the depth threshold and allows otherwise; unaudited bypass refused. VERIFY: new plugins/adlc-cursor/test/build-gate.test.mjs invoking the real hook entry with fixture payloads (offline, temp dirs), covering deny/allow/bypass-audited/bypass-unaudited.
- AC2: buildgate imports @adlc/build-gate (no inlined risk/decide copy). VERIFY: test asserts the import; grep confirms no local deriveRiskSignals/isDegraded implementation.
- AC3: flail advisory fires on a synthetic churn window, silent otherwise. VERIFY: unit test on the audit hook with fixture window.
- AC4: each of stop-audit/preflight is either (a) wired against a verified-and-ADR-pinned event, or (b) shipped disabled with the pinning TODO recorded in ADR-0006 — no invented events. VERIFY: ADR-0006 diff pins the verified facts; hooks.json only references verified events; test asserts disabled modes are absent from hooks.json.
- AC5: shell advisory emits on a fixture command targeting a rail and stays silent on a benign command; never denies. VERIFY: unit test with both fixtures asserting permission is always allow/absent.
- AC6: existing rails-guard behavior unchanged: frozen plugins/adlc-cursor/test/rails-guard.test.mjs passes with zero diff. VERIFY: node --test + git diff --stat.
- AC7: scaffold merge idempotent with the new entries; user hooks preserved. VERIFY: extended scaffold test.
- AC8: full `npm test` + both sibling smoke scripts exit 0.

tickets.title: Cursor integration truth sweep: ADR-0006, integration doc, smoke, site page
tickets.body:
Make every documentation surface tell the truth about what T16-T18 shipped — no overstated parity, no stale gaps.

=== SURFACES ===
1. docs/adr/0006-adlc-cursor-integration.md: status line updated (MVP -> command suite + prosecutor + hook parity shipped); newly pinned hook facts from T18 recorded; 'Unverified / follow-on' section updated (remove shipped items, keep live-deny-proof + any unpinned events).
2. docs/integrations/cursor.md: Install section covers command deployment; 'Formal ADLC Coverage' table updated per phase (P0/P1/P2/P4/P5/P7 gain their command surface; P3 gains buildgate; P5 gains the multi-lens loop with the weaker-independence caveat); 'Gaps' section rewritten to the real residual gaps (live deny proof; any disabled hook modes; shell writes advisory-only; sequential-lens independence caveat).
3. scripts/cursor-install-smoke.mjs: asserts everything new (commands present with frontmatter, hook entries wired, doc claims present) — the smoke IS the truth enforcement, mirror how opencode-install-smoke asserts doc language.
4. apps/docs/content/docs/integrations/cursor.mdx: replace the stub with a real page following antigravity.mdx's porting pattern from docs/integrations/cursor.md (frontmatter conventions per the existing five pages; update meta.json only if cursor is not already listed). Verify `cd apps/docs && npm run build` passes.
5. README.md / docs/README.md: only if they enumerate per-harness capabilities that are now stale (grep for cursor claims; update minimally).

=== ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA ===

- AC2: coverage table matches shipped reality 1:1 with T16-T18 deliverables. VERIFY: manual cross-check recorded in PR body; smoke asserts the caveat strings.
